title: Bryan Couchman: bold black trademarks on a lilac portfolio
note: A brand designer for Lydia to keep in mind. Bryan Couchman is a Midwest brand designer specialising in trademarks, icons and visual identity systems. His portfolio is a lilac page with a simple four-column header and a grid of heavy black marks, broken up by dark packaging shots (Surround 360 boxes) and photography.
